title: Circular asset-life option analysis
purpose: Ranks circular asset and service options using discounted cost, carbon, downtime, circularity, safety, and non-compensatory safeguards.
input: Excel wb with worksheets: Options, Parameters, Weights.
outputs: Produces the following reference outputs: cost_carbon_options.png, option_ranking.csv, run_metadata.json, summary.csv, summary.json, weighted_option_scores.png.
limitations: Educational and decision-support example only. It is not a validated clinical, regulatory, legal, procurement, accreditation, cybersecurity, or health technology assessment instrument.
